business_problem: Kelly Services needed an IT service desk that could keep up with rising support volumes and expectations from employees, clients, and job seekers, but traditional processes relied too heavily on agent memory and reactive handling to deliver fast, consistent resolution at scale.
solution_summary: Kelly Services and TCS rebuilt the company's IT service desk around an AI-assisted support stack instead of a traditional queue-based help desk. Monitoring tools and live interactions feed AI-driven call transcription and analysis so Kelly can understand how each support conversation unfolds, while intelligent knowledge search surfaces the right answer without depending on individual agent memory. Real-time predictive insights and context-aware recommendations are then presented during live interactions, giving agents guided next steps and helping the system adapt automatically as demand or service complexity changes. The same operating model supports proactive outreach when internal monitoring shows a customer may be having problems, turning the desk from a reactive contact point into an adaptive service platform for Kelly's internal workforce, external clients, and placed talent.
